title: Mit-Bestand Zwischenbericht LaTeX Workshop
description: Create mit-bestand zwischenbericht LaTeX document with placeholder content and configure LaTeX Workshop for Tectonic build.
summary: Footer left now shows each author as a shortened chip (e.g. U. Saluz, K. Sarakbi) via \footerauthors and \SemioFooterAuthorChips. Author shortening uses a robust LaTeX first-name parser in semio-core.sty. Fixed TOC aux file rename to .sctoc and register body materialize (cs_gset_nopar:cpn instead of Npx) to stop premature table expansion on second LaTeX pass. Verified in zwischenbericht.pdf footer text on pages 2–4.
